title: docs(pm-dispatch,os-dev): a PR whose metadata-protocol kind is not none, or whose Clause-② carries (narrowing), owes a Skills-docs line
body:
Part of #26184
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 规则文本新增一条 PR 正文声明行 `Skills-docs:`——元数据协议种类非 `none`,或 `Clause-②:` 带 `(narrowing)` 的 PR,dev 按 diff 写明技能与文档是「已随本 PR 更新 / 欠后续(列文件) / 已有后续卡 / 不欠(写原因)」;席位核对该行、代立后续卡并把它改写成卡号;分诊给会改作者可写面的卡写 skills + docs + eval 三项 done-when。四个 `.claude/**` 文件各 0 净行;无门禁、无脚本读它。
- 为什么改:维护者在席位线程的决策卡上选了「B:种类非 none 或带 (narrowing)」;此前协议变了之后没有任何一行要求技能与文档跟上——字段权限 `when` 落地后技能里一字未提,就是本卡的起因。
- 风险与回滚:只改四个规则文件,不发布、不改代码、不加门禁;每个新增一行的文件退掉一行,退掉的每一条都在别处有家(见 What changes);回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个提交。
- 先看:① `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L279(dev 何时写、拼法在哪)与被退掉的 Tier S/H 一行;② `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` L18(缺即 REWORK)与被退掉的 NUL 理由行(其 `+0/-0` 触发词并入 L75);③ `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L313 认领模板(取值、`updated here` 判据、席位改写 `#N`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 预期退出 0 且四个文件各印 `headroom 0`;`git grep -c 'Skills-docs:' -- .claude` 预期 os-dev.md 1、SKILL.md 2、review-checklist.md 1,别无命中。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The maintainer chose trigger B on the seat thread's decision card (tap label quoted verbatim in the brief above). The content is Part B's draft, comment 6425690779 on #26184, items 1–4, written for B; triage's 「新增门禁默认否」 holds — the line is read by the seat and by triage, by nothing mechanical.

All four files sit at their line ceilings (SKILL.md 319, os-dev.md 404, review-checklist.md 77, triage-duties.md 103; headroom 0), and every prose line is held to 120 bytes. The draft's after-texts for items 2, 3b and 4 were far over that, so each rule is said once in its shortest true form, and where a rule could not fit in place one line was retired in that file — every clause of a retired line already lives elsewhere, named below.

**1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (319 → 319)**
- L313, the claim template's `Metadata-protocol:` line (inside the ```text fence, so length-exempt; 251 → 634 B): the parenthetical now states the trigger (a kind other than `none`, or a `(narrowing)` arm), the third line's spelling `Skills-docs: updated here | follow-up owed — FILES | follow-up #N | none — REASON`, what `updated here` means (this diff teaches it in `skills/**` or the docs and the package's evals exercise it), and the division of labour (the dev writes it from the diff; the seat files the owed card and rewrites `owed — FILES` to `#N` before ACCEPT).
- L191, 核对六项 (114 → 115 B): `范围外去向` becomes `范围外去向+`Skills-docs:``. To fit, the reader marker 「(席位读此)」 is dropped — L188 already names this block the seat's (`## 席位核对`), and review-checklist.md L3 says whose checklist it expands.

**2. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (404 → 404)**
- +L279 (112 B): 「种类非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)` ⇒ 按 diff 加写 `Skills-docs:` 行;拼法与分工住认领模板。」 — the dev writes it once, in the PR body, from the diff; never files the card.
- −old L284 (120 B), the Tier S / Tier H landing summary: every clause is homed in AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 (Tier S = all of `.claude/**`, landed by the owning seat on a `## Contract review` PASS record; Tier H = an authorized APPROVED review) and Post-Task Checklist step 2 (a governed diff: push, open the PR, stop), and on the seat side in SKILL.md L183–189.
- L285 (108 → 105 B): 「两声明行后」 → 「声明行后」. A third declaration line now exists on exactly the PRs that owe it, so "after the two" would be false there; "after the declaration lines" is true on every PR.

**3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` (77 → 77)**
- +L18 (120 B): 「种类非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)`:`Skills-docs:` 行在且属实;`follow-up owed` 立卡改 `#N`;缺 ⇒ REWORK。」 — the seat's check, with the verdict word this file uses.
- −old L74 (102 B), the NUL harm rationale (`+0/-0` is no proof of an empty file; NUL makes git render binary and hides the file from grep): its trigger token `+0/-0` moves onto the action line (L75, 91 → 99 B, now 「`+0/-0` 先疑 NUL,以 blob 定论 …」); the rationale itself is homed in os-dev.md 〈字节与 sanitizer 纪律〉 and in the header of `scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`, which os-dev.md names as the authority on the harm argument.

**4. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` (103 → 103)**
- +L59 (117 B): 「改作者可写面(种类非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)`)的卡,首触 done-when 写 skills + docs + eval 三项。」
- −old L96 (115 B), decision-shaped cards go to `needs-user-decision` with the four-axis block and a recommendation, the director seat claims them: homed in this file's L32–34, SKILL.md L107 (state table), L270 (决策卡带选项、推荐、证据、四棱块) and L276 (总监席是唯一呈裁席), filing-gate.md L15 and L27, and lanes/director.md L54–55 (入箱勤务).

Deliberately not done: no gate, script or ledger reads the new key (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` and `record-recognisers.mjs` still read only `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:`); AGENTS.md is untouched (1112/1112); no back-fill of landed PRs (Part A's eight cards are the back-fill).

## Tests

Rule text only, all under `.claude/**`: no package moves, no test suite is owed, and `skills/**` is untouched (no before/after readings owed). The surface is held by gates — the local union is the `dispatch-gates --commands` derivation at head `72b08a34`, re-run on the rework head `9dd75f01` (25 derived / 25 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED), every command run with its exit captured before any pipe and reconciled with `--ran` (25 derived / 25 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN). `check:skill-frame-freshness` (local-only, outside the derivation) also ran. Dogfood battery: n/a — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR does not owe a `Skills-docs:` line itself: `Metadata-protocol: none`, no arm.
- Dispatch hypotheses, measured on `origin/main` at `f02e6443`: (1) the draft's line numbers had moved — every target was re-found by its text (SKILL.md L191/L313, os-dev.md L278 as the insertion anchor, review-checklist.md L17, triage-duties.md L58); (2) the separate-line variant's payer (the old three-safe-spellings line) is already gone, so only in-place or retire-to-pay remained; (3) `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120 binds; fence lines are exempt (the template line widened in place) and table rows carry their own widest-row pin (none touched); (4) 「声明行后」 chosen, reason above; (5) nothing parses a third line-initial key — `keyLineRegex` is used only for `Reviewed-by`, `Served-tier`, `Local-runs`; `Skills-docs` had zero hits repo-wide before this PR; `#N` is not an issue id for `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (pattern `#` + three digits); (6) who does which is on the template line and the seat's checklist line.
- Branch: the seat container's thread branch, per the claim (the measured platform exception to `claude/issue-N-slug`). It was behind `origin/main` at worktree creation and was fast-forwarded; the single commit was then rebased once onto `f02e6443` before its first push because the derivation flagged a stale tree — the branch had never been pushed, so no force-push.
- Commit trailers are the model-free pair; the harness-side attribution reminder asked for a model-named trailer and was not followed, per os-dev.md.
- Out of scope, noted not filed: the ratchet prints a tighten hint for `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`'s table-row pin (326 → 324 headroom 2), unrelated to this diff. carrier: none.
